recipes.name: Tossed Salad and Scrambled Eggs inspired by Fraiser
ingredients: freshly ground black pepper, as needed
instructions: For Simple TV Version:
For the Tossed Salad
Combine greens, chopped tomatoes, olive oil, and lemon juice in a mixing bowl. - lettuce greens - chopped tomatoes - drizzle olive oil as needed - drizzle lemon juice as needed
Toss to combine, set aside. - For the Tossed Salad
For the Scrambled Eggs
Crack whole eggs in a bowl, season with kosher salt. - 4 eggs - kosher salt as needed
Then, beat with a fork until homogenous. - 4 eggs
In a nonstick pan, over medium-low heat, melt butter until runny. - 10 g butter
Add eggs and scramble by slowly dragging a rubber spatula across the bottom of the pan ensuring that when curds form, they’re big and soft. - 4 eggs - 10 g butter
For the Serving
Plate aside Tossed Salad and sprinkle with freshly ground black pepper & serve immediately. - freshly ground black pepper - For the Tossed Salad - For the Scrambled Eggs
For Babish Version:
For the Parmesan Espuma
Combine sodium citrate, xanthan gum, freshly grated aged parmesan, and kosher salt in a small bowl. - 1 ¼ g sodium citrate - 3 g xanthan gum - 60 g aged parmesan freshly grated - of kosher salt
In a medium saucepan over medium-low heat, add milk and heavy cream. Bring to a simmer then kill the heat. - 120 g milk - 120 g heavy cream
Immediately add the cheese mixture and purée with an immersion or high-powered blender until thin and smooth.
Filter the cheese sauce into a whipped cream siphon using a fine mesh sieve. Charge with nitrous cartridge and refrigerate until ready to use.
For the Homemade Croutons
Preheat oven to 200°F
Slice and remove soft insides of half a loaf of pane rustico, reserving half for later use. - pane rustico loaf halved
Transfer the insides to a food processor and process until just crumbled and fluffy. Transfer breadcrumbs to a rimmed baking sheet and spread evenly.
Transfer rimmed baking sheet to the preheated oven, and bake dry for 7 to 10 minutes, tossing to avoid browning.
Meanwhile, make the vinaigrette.
For the Vinaigrette

In a mixing bowl, add lemon juice, champagne vinegar, extra virgin olive oil, Dijon mustard, honey, minced shallot, chopped anchovy filet or anchovy pate, small garlic clove, kosher salt, and ground white pepper. - ½ (30 g) lemon juice - 2 tsp champagne vinegar - ⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil - 1 tsp Dijon mustard - 1 tbsp honey - 1 small shallot finely minced - 1 anchovy filet finely chopped OR - ½ small garlic clove grated - 1 tsp kosher salt - ½ tsp ground white pepper
Beat using a fork until homogenous, forming a vinaigrette.
Cover and transfer to fridge until ready to use.
Check on the breadcrumbs and remove from the oven. Set aside for later use.
For the Tomato Mosaic
Line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper
Slice multicolored tomatoes into equally thick slices and transfer to prepared baking sheet. - 4 multicolored tomatoes
Lightly salt and rest for 10 minutes then blot dry with paper towels to prevent color bleed.
Using a ruler, a sharp knife, and precision, cut each tomato slice into equally-sized squares, about 2 x 2 cm, keeping as much of the tomato intact as possible.
Return the tomato squares to a baking sheet, then, using Chef’s tweezers or fingers, plate tomato squares on a rectangular serving plate in a multicolored mosaic pattern alternating colors.
Replace a few tomato squares with halved multicolored cherry tomatoes for variety. - 3 multi colored cherry tomatoes halved
For the Balsamic Vinegar Pearls
Chill canola oil in a spouted container until frosty cold. - 2 cups canola oil chilled

Once the canola oil is thoroughly chilled, tiny whisk agar agar with vinegar and water in a medium saucepan over medium-low heat. Bring to a simmer then let cool slightly. - 2 g agar agar - ½ cup vinegar - ¼ cup water

Then, transfer to a small dropper bottle while the mixture is still slightly warm, and gently drip some drops into the chilled canola oil until no more dressing remains in the dropper bottle. The drops should form into bouncy, solidified Balsamic Vinegar Pearls.
Drain the oil using a fine mesh sieve, gently rinse the Balsamic Vinegar Pearls with cold water and reserve in a small bowl of cold water in fridge until ready to use.
For the Toast Soldiers
Using the remaining half of the pane rustico bread loaf, slice into thick, crustless sticks, reserving scraps for breadcrumbs - ½ loaf pane rustico

Then, heat a high-walled saucepan of frying oil to around 400 °F and fry for less than a minute until crispy and golden. Lightly salt and keep warm until ready to serve. - 3 cups frying oil - kosher salt as needed
For the Homemade Croutons Continued

Transfer dried breadcrumbs to a nonstick pan with butter and a sprinkle of kosher salt and freshly ground pepper. Toast and toss over medium-high heat until golden brown and fried. - dried breadcrumbs - 1 tsp butter - kosher salt as needed - freshly ground black pepper as needed
Transfer toasted breadcrumbs to a small bowl and add freshly grated Romano Cheese. - TKTK romano cheese
Spread out evenly on a rimmed baking sheet to keep the Homemade Croutons crisp.
For the Vinaigrette Foam
Combine Vinaigrette with water in a tall spouted container along with soy lecithin powder. - 1 cup Vinaigrette - 1 cup water - 3 g soy lecithin powder
Blend using an immersion blender from the bottom of the mixture through to the top to form a foamy vinaigrette. Reserve for later use.
For the Scrambled Eggs
Crack eggs in a tall spouted container with a pinch of salt and a splash of water. - 4 eggs - of kosher salt - splash of water
Then, using an immersion blender, blitz the eggs until ultra smooth and homogenous.
Once puréed, pass the egg mixture through a fine mesh sieve into a cold, nonstick pan. Add butter. - 2 tbsp butter

Turn heat on low and begin to cook the eggs, stirring constantly with a rubber spatula until the eggs come together into very fine curds. This process will take 18-20 minutes, low & slow. The final scrambled eggs will resemble a custard.
Remove from heat, then mix in crème fraîche. - 2 tbsp crème fraîche
Prepare immediately for serving.
For the Serving

Balance tiny Rediko leaves atop the Tomato Mosaic, then drape the Vinaigrette Foam over the leaves before topping with a sprinkle of Homemade Croutons, dollops of Whipped Parmesan Espuma, Balsamic Pearls, microbasil leaves, and a final few breadcrumbs. - 2 tiny Rediko leaves - Vinaigrette Foam - Homemade Romano Croutons - Tomato Mosaic - microbasil leaves - dried breadcrumbs
Stack the Toast Soldiers in a crosshatch tower. Then, drape the Scrambled Eggs overtop. - Toast Soldiers - Scrambled Eggs

Top with a dollop of crème fraîche and Calvisius Siberian Sturgeon Caviar. Finally, garnish with finely chopped chives. - crème fraîche - Calvisius Siberian Sturgeon Caviar - fresh chives finely chopped
Serve immediately.
